document.title: Form PENS.C/8 — Expression of Interest to Restore Prior Contributory Service in the Case of a Deferred Retirement Benefit

chunks.part: Form PENS.C/8 — Expression of Interest to Restore Prior Contributory Service in the Case of a Deferred Retirement Benefit
chunks.heading: What form PENS.C/8 is used for and how it differs from PENS.C/1
chunks.text: Form PENS.C/8 is used to restore prior contributory service for a period for which the participant previously elected a deferred retirement benefit that is not yet in payment, under article 24 bis. This applies to deferred retirement elections made on or after 1 April 2007 (elections before that date use form PENS.C/1 instead).

chunks.part: Form PENS.C/8 — Expression of Interest to Restore Prior Contributory Service in the Case of a Deferred Retirement Benefit
chunks.heading: Deadline and consequence of missing it
chunks.text: If the participant does not elect to restore their prior contributory service within one year of re-entry into the Fund, the right to restore that period of prior contributory service is forfeited under article 24 bis.

chunks.part: Form PENS.C/8 — Expression of Interest to Restore Prior Contributory Service in the Case of a Deferred Retirement Benefit
chunks.heading: Submitting a form for multiple periods
chunks.text: A separate form PENS.C/8 must be submitted for each period of prior-contributory service the participant is interested in restoring.

chunks.part: Form PENS.C/8 — Expression of Interest to Restore Prior Contributory Service in the Case of a Deferred Retirement Benefit
chunks.heading: Final election requirement
chunks.text: The restoration will not proceed unless and until the participant submits a final election to restore using form PENS.C/9, in accordance with instructions provided with the estimate. Form PENS.C/9 must be submitted within 60 days of receipt of the estimate.

chunks.part: Form PENS.C/8 — Expression of Interest to Restore Prior Contributory Service in the Case of a Deferred Retirement Benefit
chunks.heading: Sections on form PENS.C/8
chunks.text: Section 1 - Participant information (including optional retirement number, prefixed 'R/'); Section 2 - Period of prior contributory service in the case of a deferred retirement benefit; Section 3 - Acknowledgement and signature.

chunks.part: Form PENS.C/8 — Expression of Interest to Restore Prior Contributory Service in the Case of a Deferred Retirement Benefit
chunks.heading: New entrant/re-entrant note on form PENS.C/8
chunks.text: New entrants or re-entrants may also validate non-contributory service and/or restore prior contributory service under articles 23 and 24 if applied for within one year of entry/re-entry (before separation if earlier), and may use any applicable transfer agreement under article 13.
